i am not an english speaking person, so i was wondering if anyone here can tell me how to introduce myself to someone else with more knowledge of english language than me, so i don't have to use words like XXXXX, girl, girl, girl, girl, gi, gi.

the example sentence i am going to use is from a book i am reading called the man in the high castle.

a:

it has been a bit of work but i eventually managed to come up with a slightly different version:

i am a XXXXX, i am a XXXXX, and i am a XXXXX.
